name: city_decay

edit_overlay.title: What if every human vanished… right now?
edit_overlay.counter: Population (8.2 billion) on the opening beat, then the year label. Composite after the beauty PNGs with whatif/engine/overlay.py. Not burned into these frames.
edit_overlay.sfx: Cue sheet only (sfx.json). Not in this blend.

notes: Locked camera inside the city, eye height, looking down the street. Not an overview.
The city is tiled hub blocks (Procedural City 4 and 6) with a street between them. No river and no bridge.
Poses are keyed on the opening (frames 1-95) and on channel keys after that. Tree sway is not keyed.
A low street fog throws shafts from a sun aimed down the avenue.
Year 100 is the same street, shortened and littered. Year 500 keeps broken walls, with trees and rubble in the roadway.

CPU timing on this 4-thread VM, 1080x1920, 64 samples, OpenImageDenoise, from the packed blend: frame 1 was 156 s, frame 90 was 152 s, frame 871 was 241 s, frame 1096 was 252 s. Mean 200 s. est_sec_per_frame_t4 is that mean divided by 4 and was not measured on a GPU.
